title: Gold Bar XL Apple Peach Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill pod in Apple Peach combines the perfect pairing of orchard-fresh flavours with this Apple Peach blend. Sweet, crisp apple meets smooth, juicy peach to create a wonderfully balanced fruit combination that's sure to become your new go-to all-day vape. The authentic sweetness of both fruits’ shines through with every puff, making it an excellent choice for anyone who enjoys fresh fruit flavours. Each refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an attached 10ml refill reservoir, both preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for smooth, flavourful MTL vaping. Built specifically for the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit, this refill combo is as easy to use as it is satisfying. Each pod features a built-in mesh coil for enhanced flavour delivery and consistent vapour production. Once the e-liquid is depleted, simply replace the pod and refill with a fresh unit from the expansive Gold Bar XL flavour range.
